entry: CPU-fetch fault control, not lifecycle qualification. Enter and leave the installed empty bank by the unchanged qualified read-only physical menu prefix. Move UP once from appended bank row 33 to existing stock shooting-menu row 32 while the replacement is installed. Unload restores the original modal-75 SET cell and table bindings. One ordinary OK then enters original SET at 0x00c72e10; the independently armed scoped fetch observer must record that exact CpuFetch and refuse the run. No host write seeds a frame, state, session, slot or name. No Save Current, selection, Rename commit, live setting change or persistent write is requested.

source_bindings.expectation: The first twelve keys enter root 0x61/class 0x281 at slot row 0. BACK returns to shooting-menu class 5, visible index 33. UP reaches the existing stock row at visible index 32, the reverse of the qualified prefix's final DOWN before entering the bank.

The installed parent copies the original values array and appends bank rows without changing the first 33 rows. Existing row index 32 at values+0x100 has token 0x0e and child 0x00789ed0. That child has root id 1, class 0x0f, parent 0x0078ea98 and values 0x00784ae4 containing leaf tokens 1 and 0. After inactive query admission, original SET takes its class-5 default child-entry stage (0x0e,0x1d), then requests redraw 0x92b on a successful transition. This first OK opens the choice list; no leaf OK commits a choice. A natural active query may refuse after the required original-entry fetch.

Restored modal-75 state-0 SET cell 0x00cd20a4 selects action 0x5a, whose original table entry is 0x00c72e10. The control requires this exact CPU instruction fetch, not a changed setting, helper count, JSON expectation failure or unrelated refusal.
